title: 第一卷 第17章 提升灵根品质第一卷 第18章 炼气四层
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 白狐被曹阳眼中的杀意吓得浑身一抖。
这人类杂役的手劲大得离谱！
白狐后腿乱蹬，急促地叫喊出声，“我没想害你，我只是想拿回我母亲留下的玉佩！”
曹阳的手没有丝毫松开的迹象，只是冷冷地盯着她。
白狐怕他真的下死手，语速飞快地补充，“难道你不想要那位炼丹师的遗产吗？我既然来找你帮忙，就是说明我有办法进去！”
曹阳神色微动，这才收了一些手中的力道。
“听说那位炼丹师的遗产中还有洗灵草呢。”白狐说着，又摇了摇头，“可惜了，药庐中的洗灵草全都枯死了，即便还有些灵力，也因为被其他植物的废气干扰，变成毒草了，不然的话加上炼丹师的遗产，绝对是一笔巨大的财富。”
曹阳眼神一闪，手上的力道彻底散去。
洗灵草是可以提升灵根的宝物，十分罕见。
那炼丹师的遗产中竟然还有这个？
他这五行杂灵根浊气异常多，对于灵气的转化率低得令人发指。
就拿吞服丹药来说。
十成药力，能留下一成就不错了。
若能有洗灵草提升灵根丹药的利用率将成倍暴涨，修为进度、灵气质量、战斗持久力，都将发生质的飞跃。
还有一件事。
药庐中的那些变成毒草的洗灵草对别人没用，对他曹阳来说却也同样是宝贝！
他最不怕的就是毒草，况且还有阴阳造化鼎可以合成。
“说出你知道的全部。”曹阳虽然收敛了杀意，却依然板着脸。
白狐见曹阳态度有些缓和，跌在硬板床上，大口喘息。
好一会儿，一甩身后的两条尾巴，从床上跳到破木桌上，蹲坐下来。
“枯荣药庐千年前确实是二阶炼丹师的道场，但现在早就荒废，变成了禁地。”
白狐语气凝重，说出了其中的危险。
“其中的阵法虽然残破，但一旦踏错半步，以你我的实力绝对不能幸免。”
“药庐中还有一群没有任何灵智只知道杀戮的枯木妖，实力也是不俗。”
“至于最后一点，也正是我来找你的关键。”白狐抬着头，诚恳道：“药庐常年被毒障笼罩，没有解毒丹，谁进谁死。”
曹阳默然不语。
残阵、毒瘴、枯木妖，随便拿出一个，都能让他有去无回。
这根本不是炼气初期的修士该去的地方。
曹阳冷眼看着桌上的白狐，“既然你这么说，就说明另外两大死局，你有办法破，对吧？”
白狐扬起尖下巴，抖了抖雪白的皮毛，满脸骄傲。
“那是自然，我可是高贵的灵狐，我们这一族天生灵觉极其敏锐，那残阵对我来说形同虚设，我能轻易找出一条安全通道。”
它得意地晃了晃脑袋，“我的魅惑天赋虽然对你这个怪胎无效，但稍微干扰一下那些没有灵智的枯木妖，掩盖我们的气息还是轻而易举的。”
曹阳暗自点头。
她敢往禁地跑，确实有点底牌。
白狐说到这里，两只尖耳朵却突然耷拉下来，有些泄气，“但是，还是那句话，毒障太强，没有避毒丹不行。”
“避毒丹？”曹阳皱眉。
能抗住那种毒瘴的丹药，品级绝对不能低。
哪怕他拥有净元之体，面对那种毒瘴，也绝不能托大。
这事还得从长计议。
白狐见曹阳沉默，又有些急了。
曹阳忽然笑了笑，伸手一把捏住白狐的后颈，直接将其提溜起来，往自己脖子上一绕。
两头一扣，当成了一个雪白的围脖。
content_en:
The white fox was frightened by the murderous intent in Cao Yang's eyes.
This human handyman has ridiculously strong hands!
The white fox kicked its hind legs wildly and shouted urgently, "I didn't mean to harm you, I just wanted to get back the jade pendant left by my mother!"
Cao Yang's hand showed no sign of loosening, and he just stared at her coldly.
Bai Hu was afraid that he would really kill him, so he added quickly, "Don't you want the inheritance of that alchemist? Since I came to you for help, it means that I have a way to get in!"
Cao Yang's expression moved slightly, and then he reduced some of the strength in his hands.
"I heard that the alchemist's legacy includes spirit-cleansing grass." Bai Hu said, shaking his head again, "It's a pity that all the spirit-cleansing grass in the medicine house has died. Even if there is still some spiritual power, it has been disturbed by the exhaust gas of other plants and turned into poisonous weeds. Otherwise, plus the alchemist's legacy, it will definitely be a huge wealth."
Cao Yang's eyes flashed, and the strength in his hand completely dissipated.
Spirit-washing grass is a rare treasure that can enhance spiritual roots.
Then there is this in the alchemist's legacy?
His Five Elements Miscellaneous Spirit Root has an unusually large amount of turbid energy, and its conversion rate to spiritual energy is appallingly low.
Take swallowing pills for example.
Ten percent of the medicine's potency, if only one can be left behind, it's a good achievement.
If the Spirit Cleansing Grass can be used to increase the utilization rate of spiritual root elixirs, the cultivation progress, spiritual energy quality, and combat endurance will all undergo a qualitative leap.
One more thing.
The spirit-cleansing herbs in the medicine house that turned into poisonous weeds are useless to others, but they are also treasures to him, Cao Yang!
The thing he is least afraid of is poisonous weeds, and besides, there is a Yin-Yang Fortune Cauldron that can be synthesized.
"Tell me everything you know." Although Cao Yang restrained his murderous intent, he still kept a straight face.
Seeing that Cao Yang's attitude had softened, Bai Hu fell on the hard bed and gasped for air.
After a while, he flicked his two tails behind him, jumped from the bed to the broken wooden table, and squatted down.
"Kurong Yaolu was indeed a dojo for second-level alchemists a thousand years ago, but it has long been abandoned and turned into a forbidden area."
The white fox spoke solemnly, speaking of the danger involved.
"Although the formation inside is broken, if you take even half a step wrong, you and I will definitely not be spared due to our strength."
"There is also a group of deadwood demons in Yaolu who have no intelligence and only know how to kill. They are also quite powerful."
"As for the last point, it is also the key to why I came to you." Bai Hu raised his head and said sincerely: "The Medicine House has been shrouded in poison all year round, and there is no detoxification pill. Whoever enters will die."
Cao Yang remained silent.
The Remnant Formation, the Poison Miasma, and the Deadwood Demon, any one of them can make him go away without any return.
This is simply not the place that a monk in the early stage of Qi refining should go.
Cao Yang looked at the white fox on the table coldly, "Since you said that, it means you have a way to break the other two dead ends, right?"
The white fox raised its pointed chin, shook its snow-white fur, and looked proud.
"That's natural. I am a noble spirit fox. Our clan is born with extremely sharp spiritual senses. The remaining formation is useless to me. I can easily find a safe passage."
It shook its head proudly and said, "Although my charm talent is ineffective against a freak like you, it is still easy to disturb those mindless dead wood demons and cover up our aura."
Cao Yang nodded secretly.
She dared to run into forbidden areas, so she did have some trump cards.
When the white fox said this, his two pointed ears suddenly drooped, a little discouraged, "But, again, the poison barrier is too strong, and it can't be done without the poison avoidance pill."
"Poison avoidance pill?" Cao Yang frowned.
The elixir that can resist that kind of poisonous miasma must not be of a low grade.
Even if he has a pure body, he can never be too big in the face of that kind of poisonous miasma.
This matter needs to be considered in the long run.
Seeing Cao Yang's silence, Bai Hu became a little anxious again.
Cao Yang suddenly smiled, reached out and pinched the back of the white fox's neck, lifted it up and wrapped it around his own neck.
Buckle it at both ends and use it as a snow-white scarf.
